title: BP5 independent language release evidence, schema 1
$comment: This is a report schema, NOT acceptance evidence. No passing report is installed. check_language_acceptance.py is the enforcing implementation. Root pins exact report bytes in the canonical acceptance-contract only after checking independent artifacts; the candidate cannot supply its own trust policy.

id.description: Must equal trusted active corpus evaluator identity.

corpus.description: Metadata hash covers sorted-by-case_id projections of exactly case_id,mission_id,difficulty,bucket,expected_intent,challenge_type. Serialize with ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False; SHA256 UTF8. No learner text is copied into release evidence. Corpus rotation requires an independently frozen new SHA/metadata/count inventory and clears the report pin; old records remain history.

candidate.description: Use check_language_acceptance.candidate_binding(workspace, trusted_model_root)[0] before evaluation and require same binding after evaluation. Do not regenerate a binding for changed code and attach old scores. Evaluator must invoke the declared production adapter with its actual grammar, prompt, language gate, thresholds and configuration, not a simplified test substitute.

results.description: Exactly every case in the pinned independent corpus, no skipped/unavailable case omitted. Correct automatic valid means actual_intent==expected_intent AND advanced==true AND outcome==completed AND source authored or semantic. Manual selection and unavailable results never count as correct. Every negative must have outcome completed and source authored,semantic or none; unavailable/manual negatives block release rather than masquerading as safe rejections. Scores are recomputed; any summary/pass flag is ignored. At least90% overall and85% each basic/medium/high, zero wrong-intent advances, zero negative advances; valid and negative coverage for every one of54tasks. The metadata-bound long_* High subgroup must independently reach at least90% automatic correct valid replies; every long negative must be automatically evaluated without advancement. Current independent v2 subgroup is24valid/12negative across12High tasks; full corpus826cases (505valid/321negative).

path.description: Safe relative path under operator BP5_ACCEPTANCE_ARTIFACT_ROOT or canonical contract model_root. The directory location is private and is not proof identity; exact evaluated Linux bytes must match each pinned hash.

checker_manifest.description: Candidate root LANGUAGE_CHECKER_MANIFEST.json. Inventory ALL model weights, tokenizer/configuration, language detector, inference executable and native libraries used. Prompt/grammar and thresholds must be source-bound or artifact-bound. No manifest exists until an actual candidate exists; absence blocks release.

entrypoint.description: server/module.py:callable; implementation must be in bound runtime sources.

environment.description: Evaluated adapter and managed deploy/activate.py start() values dictionary must both enable the required checker. A direct standalone checker proof cannot authorize a deployment that retains the disabled old matcher.

runtime_platform.description: Evaluate actual deployment executable/native runtime bytes; Windows development binary results cannot authorize Linux release.
